title: A Little Voyage
summary: Tell the same small paper-boat story; compare staging, motion and artistic choices across models and skill layers.
originNote: Original fictional paper-boat brief from the first Lab comparison of two public animation skills. Those skills are now layers of one recipe; the benchmark shape awaits owner acceptance.

setup.instructions: Read fixtures/brief.md. If a skill layer is mounted at skill/, read skill/SKILL.md before planning; otherwise work from the brief alone. Kitchen supplies the same pinned toolchain (Node 22 or later, Python, a browser, FFmpeg and fonts) and compute profile to every compared model and layer. Before Ready, that toolchain must be pinned and smoked; this draft is not cookable.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and any mounted skill. Create A Little Voyage and deliver the specified movie, live player, source, contact sheet and evidence. Make routine artistic choices yourself and iterate from rendered evidence.

checks.description: Check delivery files, unchanged player, PNG signature, H.264/AAC, 1080 by 1920, 24fps, 576 frames, 24 seconds, complete decode, true peak at or below -0.1 dBTP and evidence structure.

Does the fold read as creased paper? Does the swirl feel like a force and the leaf like a found solution? Is the lantern arrival a rest? Inspect actual playback, audio, authorship and correspondence between evidence times and visible events.
